how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-thousand-needles-01.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:1100:details:0: You slowly open the weathered journal of Henrig Lonebrow....
rows.quest:1100:completion:0: You say you found this journal on a deceased dwarf? Give me but a moment to peruse the pages...
rows.quest:1104:obj:0: Bring 6 Salty Scorpid Venoms to Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1104:details:0: I have so many designs for our rocket car! So many! And I must try them all!!
rows.quest:1104:details:1: BI'm working on a new type of fuel. One that burns really really really hot!! I haven't gotten the mixture perfect, but I think I know what I need...
rows.quest:1104:details:2: BThe scorpids who wander the Shimmering Flats have a venom with lots and lots of salt in it. It's very unique! And it's just what I need!
rows.quest:1104:details:3: BBring me venom and trust me -- our car will fly!!
rows.quest:1104:completion:0: All right! This venom is going to work great! Thanks, ⟦1⟧!
rows.quest:1104:completion:1: BNow I just need to boil it down, apply skipper-otomer, add a nega-catalyst, and... Drat! Where are my notes!?
rows.quest:1105:obj:0: Bring 9 Hardened Tortoise Shells to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1105:details:0: My brother is working on a new fuel for his rocket car. He's brilliant, he really is. So brilliant that... I think that new fuel he's designing is strong enough to eat right through the car's chassis!
rows.quest:1105:details:1: BI want to reinforce its fuel tanks before that happens.
rows.quest:1105:details:2: BThe tortoises out on the flats have very hard shells. I want to use them to create new tanks for our rocket car. Tanks that can hold my brother's new fuel.
rows.quest:1105:details:3: BYou look responsible enough. Will you get me those shells?
rows.quest:1106:obj:0: Bring Fizzle's Letter to Martek the Exiled in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1106:details:0: I'm developing a new engine that'll make the car go so fast! Fast enough to fly, I know it! I just need to make pistons that can handle very very heavy stress. All my trials have failed because I can't make pistons hard enough!
rows.quest:1106:details:1: BBut there is someone who might know how.
rows.quest:1106:details:2: BHis name is Martek the Exiled. He is a great smith and knows more about metal than anyone. Take him this letter, I know he can help!
rows.quest:1106:details:3: BBut he's far far away -- in ⟦E2⟧, in the ⟦E1⟧, in a camp, with a goblin!
rows.quest:1106:completion:0: Fizzle sent you? Well that changes things! Of course I'll help you. Fizzle and his brother are two of the few people who don't want me dead!
rows.quest:1106:completion:1: BSo Fizzle wants to make pistons, eh? Pistons strong enough to take whatever stresses he has planned, and if I know Fizzle, then this new car of his is a volcano on wheels!
rows.quest:1107:obj:0: Bring 10 Encrusted Tail Fins to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1107:details:0: Our rocket car is the fastest thing on the flats! So fast that ... I'm afraid friction is going to tear it apart!
rows.quest:1107:details:1: BTo prevent that I need to create a composite to coat the car's moving parts. It must be hard but not brittle, and must be resistant to salt corrosion, or time spent on the Shimmering Flats will eat it away.
rows.quest:1107:details:2: BHave you heard of the Vile Reef, ⟦3⟧? It's off the coast of ⟦E3⟧. Saltscale murlocs live there, and their tail fins are a crucial ingredient of my composite.
rows.quest:1107:completion:0: Thank you, ⟦4⟧! After I grind these down and fuse them with a few other ingredients, the composite will be ready. And after that, the car will be safe from its own speed.
rows.quest:1107:completion:1: BSafe, as long as it doesn't hit anything...
rows.quest:1108:obj:0: Bring 10 Indurium Flakes to Martek the Exiled in the ⟦E1⟧.
rows.quest:1108:details:0: I'm not out here just to stay away from people. There is a wealth of metal in the ⟦E1⟧, ⟦5⟧, if you have the guts to get it.
rows.quest:1108:details:1: BThe metal's called indurium and as luck would have it, it is rumored to possess high resistance to heat and stress. It might work for Fizzle's car.
rows.quest:1108:details:2: BBut let's make sure. Get me samples of indurium and I'll test its properties.
rows.quest:1108:details:3: BTrue indurium ore lies deep in Uldaman, but the Stonevault troggs of the ⟦E1⟧ sometimes have flakes of it on them. Bring me those flakes.
rows.quest:1108:completion:0: Ah yes, these will do fine. Now let's put them in some heat and see how they fare...
rows.quest:1110:obj:0: Bring 30 Rocket Car Parts to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1110:details:0: Heh heh, with all the races they're running here, it's no surprise that a few mishaps happen along the way. If you look around the Shimmering Flats then you'll see evidence of past crashes -- scraps of rocket car parts are littered everywhere!
rows.quest:1110:details:1: BAnd those parts are worth money to the gnomes and goblins. They're always looking for more contraptions to slap onto their cars.
rows.quest:1110:details:2: BSo go out and get me parts. Bring me a heap and I'll pay you well.
rows.quest:1110:completion:0: Whoa, look at all that! There's some good stuff in that heap of junk. I'm sure I can pawn it off for a hefty sum.
rows.quest:1110:completion:1: BAnd... is that an ear I see squashed between those two sheets of metal?? Ouch! Heh, I sure wouldn't want to be that pilot!
rows.quest:1110:completion:2: BThanks, ⟦6⟧. Here's your pay. And here's some advice, free of charge...
rows.quest:1110:completion:3: BIf you look hard enough, you can always find profit in someone else's tragedy.
rows.quest:1111:obj:0: Bring Kravel's Parts Order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig in Ratchet.
rows.quest:1111:details:0: I make it my job to get people what they need, and the gnomes over there need a parts order filled. Their parts were shipped to Ratchet a week ago, but I haven't been able to make the trip.
rows.quest:1111:details:1: BSo, are you ready for some legwork? Go to Ratchet and give this parts order to Wharfmaster Dizzywig -- he'll probably be at the docks.
rows.quest:1111:details:2: BDo this for me, and I'll have more jobs for you.
rows.quest:1111:details:3: BJobs, my friend, with serious profit potential...
rows.quest:1111:completion:0: Oh yes. Parts for Kravel. I'm glad you're here. These things have been sitting out here for days, and I was afraid they'd rust!
rows.quest:1112:obj:0: Bring Kravel's Parts to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1112:details:0: Here's Kravel's package, ⟦7⟧. And when you deliver it, tell him... if he wants more special orders, then he'll have to pay his tab!
rows.quest:1112:completion:0: Great, you got them! Now we need to get them to the gnomes. But first...
rows.quest:1112:completion:1: BLet's take out one small item...
rows.quest:1114:obj:0: Bring the Delicate Car Parts to Fizzle Brassbolts in Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1114:details:0: Now that I have what I need, give these parts to Fizzle Brassbolts. He's been waiting a long time for them -- I'm sure he won't miss the little piece I removed from his order...
rows.quest:1114:details:1: BAnd I wouldn't bother mentioning it to him. It was small and worthless.
rows.quest:1114:completion:0: There they are! My hydro ratchets and repeater bolts! These will do just fine. Thank you!
rows.quest:1115:obj:0: Talk to Krazek in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:1115:details:0: Now that we've done a service for the gnomes, it's time to do the goblins a favor!
rows.quest:1115:details:1: BI hear that the goblin racer pilot, Nazz Steamboil, didn't always use that name. I wonder why he changed it. I wonder if it's a secret, and... I wonder if he values that secret.
rows.quest:1115:details:2: BIf anyone knows the truth, then it's Krazek of Booty Bay, on the southern tip of Stranglethorn. Speak with Krazek and ask him about our goblin pilot.
rows.quest:1115:details:3: BIf you can get useful information from him, then we might just turn a profit from it.
rows.quest:1115:completion:0: You want to know about Nazz Steamboil? He's a racer pilot out in the Shimmering Flats, isn't he?
rows.quest:1115:completion:1: BYeah, I might be able to find something out about him... but it won't be easy. Or fast.
rows.quest:1117:obj:0: Bring the Goblin Rumors to Kravel Koalbeard in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1117:details:0: I had to use some of my favors, and gave away a rare bottle of elven wine, and did some heavy deducing myself! But I found the information you seek.
rows.quest:1117:details:1: BHere, I wrote a letter with some very interesting bits on our friend, Nazz Steamboil. Do with it what you will -- it's too dangerous for me to use.
rows.quest:1117:details:2: BJust don't tell anyone where you got it!
rows.quest:1117:completion:0: Well well! This is interesting... very interesting. Heh, perhaps I should bow to the goblin pilot the next time I see him.
rows.quest:1117:completion:1: BThis is worth plenty, ⟦8⟧. I'm sure Nazz will pay a small fortune to keep his secret... a secret.
rows.quest:1118:obj:0: Bring Kravel's Scheme to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:1118:details:0: ⟦9⟧, you're a ⟦10⟧ I can trust, both to get the job done and to keep your mouth shut while doing it.
rows.quest:1118:details:1: BI've been brewing up a new scheme. It's risky, but if it works then we could both make a bundle! And I think you're just the person to see it through.
rows.quest:1118:details:2: BTo start, you must go back to Booty Bay. I apologize, good ⟦11⟧. I know my last task took you there. But this time, speak with Crank Fizzlebub.
rows.quest:1118:details:3: BGive him this letter. And if he requires aid, do your best to help him. It will be worth the effort.
rows.quest:1118:completion:0: I see. Kravel has a big scheme planned. He has a sinister mind -- I like that about him.
rows.quest:1118:completion:1: BSo you'll need something to addle wits, eh? Something powerful...
rows.quest:1118:completion:2: BI wonder if the mixture Zanzil feeds his zombies could be used...
rows.quest:1119:obj:0: Bring the Fool's Stout back to Kravel in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1119:details:0: I figured out how to use Zanzil's mixture with stout to make a powerful libation. A Fool's Stout. I think it'll be just what Kravel needs, but try it out and let me know how it works.
rows.quest:1119:details:1: BAnd ⟦12⟧, don't keep this stuff too long without using it. Zanzil's mixture has a weird effect on the stout's yeast, kicking it into high gear. So it won't stay fresh forever.
rows.quest:1119:completion:0: Wonderful! Fizzlebub came through! I'll remember that next time I see him.
rows.quest:1119:completion:1: BAnd thank you, ⟦13⟧. You're doing a great job, and we both stand to make a lot of money from this...
rows.quest:1120:obj:0: Bring the Fool's Stout to the Gnome Pit Boss.
rows.quest:1120:details:0: We need to try the Fool's Stout on one of the pit crews. If you want to try it on the gnomes, then here -- take the stout and give it to the gnome pit boss.
rows.quest:1120:details:1: BAnd don't wait too long. This stout will go bad eventually.
rows.quest:1120:completion:1: BWe shouldn't be drinking with the race coming up, but... maybe my boys could do with just a little. Besides, it can't be that strong, can it?
rows.quest:1121:obj:0: Bring the Fool's Stout to the Goblin Pit Boss.
rows.quest:1121:details:0: We need to try the Fool's Stout on one of the pit crews. If you want to try it on the goblins, then here -- take the stout and give it to the goblin pit boss.
rows.quest:1121:details:1: BAnd don't wait too long. This stout will go bad eventually.
rows.quest:1121:completion:0: What do we have here? Booze, eh?
rows.quest:1121:completion:1: BWell, I don't mind if we have just a little...
rows.quest:1122:obj:0: Bring the Fool's Stout report to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:1122:details:0: That Fool's Stout worked great! I placed a bet on the next race, and... let's hope the crew you got drunk did a number on their car!
rows.quest:1122:details:1: BThere's only one more task for you -- take this note back to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay. He'll want to know of the successful test.
rows.quest:1122:details:2: BAnd hopefully we can get more of that Fool's Stout for future races!
rows.quest:1122:completion:0: It says here that the fool's stout was a success. That's good news!
rows.quest:1122:completion:1: BIf you ever want more of the stuff, then let me know and I'll have you gather more of Zanzil's Mixture.
rows.quest:1137:obj:0: Speak with Fizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1137:details:0: Indurium has an amazing resistance to heat! I'm sure it will work for Fizzle's pistons. But he'll need true indurium ore, not just the flakes.
rows.quest:1137:details:1: BTo get the ore, it must be mined from deep within Uldaman, on the northern borders of the ⟦E1⟧. That is the true source of indurium.
rows.quest:1137:details:2: BSend Fizzle Brassbolts my regards, and tell him what I told you.
rows.quest:1137:details:3: BSafe travels, ⟦14⟧. And it won't surprise me if we meet again -- once Fizzle learns of indurium he'll probably send you to Uldaman to acquire it!
rows.quest:1137:completion:0: ⟦15⟧, you're back! You found Martek? You spoke with him? What did he say? Can he help??
rows.quest:1137:completion:1: BTell me, tell me, tell me!!
rows.quest:1147:obj:0: Kill 5 Silithid Searchers, 5 Silithid Hive Drones, and 5 Silithid Invaders and return to Moktar Krin in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1147:details:0: Hmm. Seems Belgrom thinks those monsters are a threat. He wants them pushed back into whatever depths they crawled up out of.
rows.quest:1147:details:1: BI guess killing the dwarves sent by the Explorers' League wasn't enough--now I have to send a half-dead war party into another battle. We won't be able to do it ourselves; not while we're in this condition. The dig site's to the south of here. There shouldn't be anymore dwarves to deal with. Feel up to wielding a blade or staff and doing your part to aid us?
rows.quest:1147:completion:0: Ha! That ichor you're covered in actually makes you prettier, ⟦16⟧! It certainly does make you reek at the same time though. Don't stand too close to the kodo; you'll either start a stampede or cause them to go into heat.
rows.quest:1147:completion:1: BI think my companions would agree that your smell alone is proof you've done your part to help us against those insect creatures. Thank you, ⟦17⟧.
rows.quest:1148:obj:0: Bring 1 Silithid Heart, 5 Silithid Talons, and 3 Intact Silithid Carapaces, to Korran at the Crossroads.
rows.quest:1148:details:0: You inspect the carapace carefully. As you turn it over in your hands you realize that the chitinous plating is interlaced in such a way that makes it incredibly strong. It's unlike anything you've ever seen. You inspect the rest of the corpse further and realize that these creatures are very powerful and highly evolved.
rows.quest:1148:details:1: BLooking down at the carapace again, you think that Korran would enjoy studying more of these creatures. It could help him figure out what these creatures are, and where they come from.
rows.quest:1148:completion:0: Ahh, you've seen Moktar recently? He always be lookin' out for me. I'm sorry to hear he spends his time watching over his little war band instead of seeing battle, but I'm sure he be takin' great joy in killing members of the Explorers' League.
rows.quest:1148:completion:1: BYou be smart to bring me these specimens, ⟦18⟧. Along with the eggs we be findin' in the Field of Giants, these should give me a good start in figuring out what these insects are, and what they be wantin'.
rows.quest:1149:obj:0: If you have faith, leap from the planks overlooking ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1149:details:0: So, you have sought me out, or perhaps destiny brings you to me? No matter. You are here now, and so your journey will begin anew.
rows.quest:1149:details:1: BMany facets make up a being: the spirit, the body, the mind. Some of these can be measured by a culture's traditions. Others we can only hope exist within ourselves. If you agree, I shall test some of the facets within you.
rows.quest:1149:details:2: BIf you pass, then you shall become stronger. If you fail, then you will realize the vastness of the Nether.
rows.quest:1149:details:3: BThe first is a Test of Faith.
rows.quest:1149:completion:0: It is not until faced with unforeseen adversity that we begin to see how strong our spirits are. You took the leap of faith even though you had no guarantees that you would survive. Your mind is open, and your spirit is prepared for what is to come.
rows.quest:1149:completion:1: BIf you are willing, then the next of your tests is ready.
rows.quest:1150:obj:0: Bring Grenka's ⟦E5⟧ to Dorn Plainstalker in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1150:details:0: I'm pleased to see your courage remains steadfast in light of what you've already done. Since your faith is intact, the time has come to test your body.
rows.quest:1150:details:1: BFirst is a test of endurance. Go to the Roguefeather Den west of Freewind Post. Make your way to the depths of their lair and destroy their foodstuffs. By then you should have provoked their fury, and if you are able to survive long enough, Grenka Bloodscreech herself will come for you--kill her and bring me her claw to complete your test.
rows.quest:1150:completion:0: Grenka was powerful, even by troll standards. You should be proud of your accomplishment this day.
rows.quest:1150:completion:1: BDuring your test of faith you displayed strength of spirit, and now you have shown endurance in battle by taking on the Roguefeather harpies, but the time has come for a new test.
rows.quest:1151:obj:0: Bring Fragments of Rok'Alim to Dorn Plainstalker in ⟦E4⟧.
rows.quest:1151:details:0: During the time of the Old Gods, elementals inhabited much of this world. They worshipped the Old Gods, and the Gods, through their power, kept the elementals bound to this world. When the Old Gods were banished, the elementals faded from our world and now only return at the bidding of powerful mages.
rows.quest:1151:details:1: BThere are exceptions though. Some elementals were powerful enough to remain here on their own. One such elemental is Rok'Alim.
rows.quest:1151:details:2: BTo test your strength, find Rok'Alim in ⟦E4⟧ and slay him.
rows.quest:1151:completion:0: The Test of Strength is done. You have shown strength and bravery, and you are now prepared for the final test before these rites are completed.
rows.quest:1152:obj:0: Find Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1152:details:0: Your time with me is just about finished. I am knowledgeable, but the Test of Lore is not mine to give. There are lessons to be learned and places to visit that others claim domain over.
rows.quest:1152:details:1: BIf you are prepared, then seek out Braug Dimspirit--he is a shaman of great wisdom. He will test you further, so heed his words, ⟦19⟧.
rows.quest:1152:details:2: BWhen you are ready, find the tunnel that connects the ⟦E6⟧ with ⟦E7⟧: Braug dwells near there. And be careful, ⟦20⟧, the night elves may wish to impede your test.
rows.quest:1152:completion:0: The days and nights grow colder throughout the world as goblins rape the land, and the night elves point fingers at the younger races. The ⟦E8⟧ and orcs are not the only ones to blame for the hardships found throughout ⟦E9⟧ and Lordaeron. Many of the intelligent races have contributed to the world's pain. Dorn knows this, and he has sent you to me because you have shown the attributes necessary to realize it also.
rows.quest:1154:obj:0: Find the Legacy of the Aspects and return it to Braug Dimspirit near the entrance to Talondeep Path in ⟦E6⟧.
rows.quest:1154:details:0: You have passed Dorn's tests, and now you seek to pass your next trial. Very good. But up until now, your challenges have been childish. It is easy to test your body--your mind is another matter completely.
rows.quest:1154:details:1: BI shall explain it simply: find the book I name, study it, and answer my question about its contents.
rows.quest:1154:details:2: BWhat book, you must be asking? The Legacy of the Aspects. It can be found at the bottom of Dor'danil in southern ⟦E7⟧, protected by the dead druids and their slayers.
rows.quest:1154:completion:0: This is the book I named. There is hope you will answer my question correctly then... unless you've forgotten to study its contents.
rows.quest:1154:completion:1: BWhen you are prepared, speak to me again and I shall ask a question of you.
rows.quest:1159:details:0: Well done, ⟦21⟧. You have passed the first portion of the Test of Lore, but there is still another question to be answered. But that question is not mine to ask.
rows.quest:1159:details:1: BSeek out Parqual Fintallas in Lordaeron City. He was a great historian for the humans before the Plague overtook him. Now he continues to seek enlightenment, but of a different nature.
rows.quest:1159:details:2: BHe will have another requirement of you before he asks you anything, but you have done masterfully thus far--I'm sure you will overcome his obstacle.
rows.quest:1159:completion:2: BBraved Dor'Danil, took a leap of faith, fought and overpowered a powerful elemental? Bah! You're probably a farce; some adventurer that overheard talk in a tavern. And now you think you have what it takes to pass my test. So be it... ⟦23⟧.
rows.quest:1175:obj:0: Kill 10 Saltstone Basilisks, 10 Saltstone Crystalhides and 6 Saltstone Gazers for Trackmaster Zherin on the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1175:details:0: After the big crash with the goblins' Red Thunder racer and a basilisk, Kronkrider hired me on to take care of the track. I don't know what all the animals out on the flats are feeding on to grow so big, but we have to be careful to thin them out so they won't wander onto the track when a race is going on.
rows.quest:1175:details:1: BTell you what. If you want to go out and make a little profit, go out and remove the basilisks from the area.
rows.quest:1175:completion:0: I hope you didn't kill any of the basilisks on the tracks themselves! It takes a long time for the carcasses to decay in the sun, and I'd rather not have to take a shovel out to clean up.
rows.quest:1176:obj:0: Get 10 Hollow Vulture Bones for Pozzik in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1176:details:0: When it comes to racing, every bit counts! Whether it's a minor tweaking on the power output, a slight slackening on the tension coils, or lightening the weight of the frame, you have to take everything into account.
rows.quest:1176:details:1: BWe use vulture bones for a lot of the minor structural tweaks we make to our racers, which offer the perfect balance of strength and weight. Even better, it's easy for us to get more, as the salt flats are littered with vultures.
rows.quest:1176:details:2: BBring me some and I'll give you a good price on them.
rows.quest:1176:completion:0: Great! I can get the crew working on this right away. Thanks, ⟦24⟧!
rows.quest:1178:details:0: Our racing team is the pride of goblins everywhere. You'd be surprised at some of the people who contribute in one way or another to our team.
rows.quest:1178:details:1: BYou know Gazlowe? He tracks down parts from around the world for us. He even came down to work on one of our rigs once!
rows.quest:1178:details:2: BA few weeks ago, he said he'd send us a new prototype fuel regulator but it hasn't come yet. He's usually very prompt... Maybe you wouldn't mind going to Ratchet to ask him about it? I wouldn't be so pushy, but the gnomes are gaining on us!
rows.quest:1178:completion:0: Pozzik sent you, huh? You know, Pozzik was one of the most respected tinkerers in Undermine before he retired to start working on the racers.
rows.quest:1178:completion:1: BThe first thing he did when he joined the team was develop the two engine model racers. Could be that the businesses will suffer without him working with the Tinkers' Union, but who cares, right? There's nothing like the races!
rows.quest:1179:obj:0: Bring the crate of crash helmets to Wizzle Brassbolts in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1179:details:0: You ever heard of the Shimmering Flats? It's a stretch of salt flats way over in ⟦E9⟧, just south of the ⟦E4⟧ canyon. It's a great place for racing because, well, it's so flat!
rows.quest:1179:details:1: BA couple of gnome brothers are out there, friends of mine, trying out their new rocket car, and from what I hear it's fast! Heh, so fast that their pilots keep crashing. Giving themselves concussions.
rows.quest:1179:details:2: BSo they asked me for some Siege Engine helmets, but I have duties here. I can't make the trip!
rows.quest:1179:completion:0: Ah! Longbeard sent you with a load of helmets! Hooray!
rows.quest:1179:completion:1: BNow maybe we can talk a pilot into driving our car...
rows.quest:1180:obj:0: Speak with Wharfmaster Lozgil in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:1180:details:0: Back to what you came here about. I know I promised Pozzik that I'd deliver a new fuel regulator for him, but I still haven't received it yet. Revilgaz over in Booty Bay said he'd have it shipped over, but it might be it slipped through the cracks somehow.
rows.quest:1180:details:1: BIf that's true, there's not much we can do about it. We can at least find out if it was dispatched from Booty Bay.
rows.quest:1180:details:2: BCheck in with Wharfmaster Lozgil over there, he should be able to check the cargo records.
rows.quest:1180:completion:0: Shipments to Ratchet? Let me just check the logbooks...
rows.quest:1180:completion:1: BNo, the most recent shipment I have on record of going out to Ratchet were boots from Drizzlik. Hasn't been much else, other than building supplies and tools. Definitely no race parts.
rows.quest:1181:obj:0: Speak with Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:1181:details:0: I'm afraid I can't be of much more help to you, ⟦25⟧. If you'd like to follow up on it more, I'd suggest you go hit up the Baron himself. If there's anyone who knows Revilgaz's business, it's Revilgaz.
rows.quest:1181:details:1: BYou'll find him at the tavern across the harbor, top floor.
rows.quest:1181:completion:0: Oh, sure of course I know what you're talking about. Nope, can't help you though. Some of my men were supposed to go track down the blueprints for the fuel regulator, but they came back empty-handed.
rows.quest:1182:obj:0: Bring the Fuel Regulator Blueprints to Baron Revilgaz in Booty Bay.
rows.quest:1182:details:0: See, the Venture Company shredders out in Lake Nazferiti (in northern Stranglethorn) have been equipped with a new model fuel regulator. I was thinking that Pozzik would be able to take advantage of it, if he could get some details. Unfortunately, Cozzle, the foreman out there, appears to be a little more clever than I gave him credit for.
rows.quest:1182:details:1: BYou seem like you might have more luck finding the blueprints though. I know he keeps them in his house, but they're almost certainly under lock and key.
rows.quest:1182:completion:0: Now, let me just get a copy of these blueprints for my own notes and you can bring these straight to Pozzik. Wouldn't want him to think that one of his sponsors was abandoning him.
rows.quest:1183:obj:0: Deliver the Fuel Regulator Blueprints to Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1183:details:0: You should be all set to go. Give Pozzik my regards and tell him that if he ever needs anything, not to hesitate to ask. I'll be waiting for the news that he breaks the track record soon!
rows.quest:1183:completion:0: I was hoping that it would be already assembled, but this does present the unique opportunity to improve on the design from the ground up. Thanks, ⟦26⟧. I'll be able to sketch up some improved schematics, build the thing, and have it installed real soon.
rows.quest:1184:details:0: Head back to Belgrom in ⟦E11⟧ and tell him Moktar be doing his bidding well out in the ⟦E4⟧. Tell him also, that me studies progress, and I hope to be havin' learned more soon. That should please him greatly.
rows.quest:1184:completion:0: I'm appreciative of your efforts, ⟦27⟧. The warchief will enjoy hearing how tenacious you have been in your duties.
rows.quest:1184:completion:1: BOh, of course I will mention your name to him. He speaks to me often and values my opinions greatly.
rows.quest:1184:completion:2: BGo now, I have much to do. And if you speak to Korran soon, and he has news of these creatures, then return to me--I would think they are a threat that must be taken seriously.
rows.quest:1186:obj:0: Speak with Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1186:details:0: I'm going to be busy with working on integrating this new fuel regulator to our racer designs, but if you'd like to help out the team some more, talk to Razzeric. He's our pilot--well, our eighteenth pilot, to be exact--and he likes to add his own little modifications to the racers.
rows.quest:1186:details:1: BHe's a little off his rocker, though, so try not to act too surprised.
rows.quest:1186:completion:0: You're the ⟦28⟧ that's been helping Pozzik out, right? I was like you once, running around the pit area, helping with whatever work the mechanics would let me do.
rows.quest:1186:completion:1: BNow look at me! The goblin racing team's pilot extraordinaire!
rows.quest:1187:obj:0: Retrieve the Seaforium Booster for Razzeric in the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1187:details:0: Pozzik's a great mechanic, I know that, but he's afraid to just load on the firepower and grab on for the ride. Not me, though.
rows.quest:1187:details:1: BAfter Pozzik finishes with a racer, I take a little time to put my own modifications on--you know, loosening up the controls, removing parts of the frame, and adding more juice!
rows.quest:1187:details:2: BI ordered a seaforium booster from Shreev at the Gizmorium in Gadgetzan, but apparently the zeppelin it was being sent on crashed in ⟦E12⟧! I gotta have it, ⟦29⟧!
rows.quest:1187:completion:0: Just take a look at this beauty! Fifteen pounds of solid seaforium power! Once I get this strapped on to the side of my racer, I'll be around the track so fast I'll beat the gnomes twice!
rows.quest:1188:obj:0: Bring the Seaforium Booster to Shreev in Gadgetzan.
rows.quest:1188:details:0: But wait, what's this? Shreev left the safety on. That will limit the amount of power I can draw from the booster at any time. I told him I wanted it off! This is no good.
rows.quest:1188:details:1: BYou have to take this to the Gadgetzan Gizmorium in the ⟦E13⟧ Desert and have Shreev remove this.
rows.quest:1188:completion:0: Only Razzeric would take a look at this and say that I'd somehow put some sort of safety lock on it. This booster is almost completely seaforium explosives. I already modified it so that more of its payload would be delivered upon use, but Razzeric is never content unless he goes to eleven!
rows.quest:1189:obj:0: Return the Modified Seaforium Booster to Razzeric on the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1189:details:0: There, I did what Razzeric wanted. Just tell him to be careful when he sets this off. If he makes the slightest mistake, he won't be moving forward, he'll just be a burnt spot on the track.
rows.quest:1189:details:1: BWould be a shame, too, if that happened. Who knows if our nineteenth driver would be any good?
rows.quest:1189:completion:0: Now that's more like it! I wish I could see the look on the gnomes' eyes when they see me set this baby off.
rows.quest:1189:completion:1: BToo bad I'll be too busy pulling off a new course record!
rows.quest:1190:obj:0: Have Zamek create a diversion, then steal Rizzle's plans for Pozzik on the Shimmering Flats.
rows.quest:1190:details:0: The Brassbolts brothers have discovered a new building material, that's the only explanation that makes sense. Their cars have been operating faster than before, but their designs, and all the other data we've gathered from their runs is identical.
rows.quest:1190:details:1: BWhat we do know, is that Rizzle Brassbolts has been focused on the plans for this new discovery almost constantly.
rows.quest:1190:details:2: BZamek can create a diversion for you, so that you can steal those plans from them.
rows.quest:1190:completion:0: Scribbled in a hasty, hurried hand, a scroll of notes and designs for the refinement of some raw material.
